brief: Complete the previously raised gasket repair before the forecast heat event begins, as it is an outstanding work order that must be addressed under SOP-016. If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as instructed in MG-023. This unit of advanced age with a history of high loading has a reduced margin against mechanical failure under the thermal cycling of a multi-day heat event [MG-023, SOP-016, MG-021].
